hunks.baseline: As I listened to the unending account, I had to hold my breath again and again.
hunks.sol: As I listened to the account unfold, I found myself holding my breath again and again.

hunks.baseline: It had been all but inevitable, but hearing the news from the current Alliance Leader himself gave it a weight unlike any other.
hunks.sol: I’d known it was all but inevitable. Still, hearing it from the current Alliance Leader himself gave the news a different weight.

hunks.baseline: Of course, the sheer numbers were part of what made it so weighty.
hunks.sol: The sheer numbers had something to do with that, too.

hunks.baseline: I suddenly remembered the last time I’d seen the Son of Heaven.
hunks.sol: I remembered the last time I’d seen him.

hunks.baseline: His aged appearance belied his youth, and his face was as pale as a sheet. The ruler of a vast continent had been on the brink of death. He surely would have died before long.
hunks.sol: His aged face belied his youth, and his complexion had been as pale as a sheet. The ruler of a vast continent had been on the brink of death. Before long, he surely would have died.

hunks.baseline: A secret art of the Maoshan Sect—and, at the same time, demonic martial arts that defied all common sense.
hunks.sol: A secret art of the Maoshan Sect—and demonic martial arts that defied all common sense.

hunks.baseline: The more one practiced it, the more one became a jiangshi. It was no better than a poisoned Holy Grail, but the Son of Heaven seemed to have drunk from it willingly.
hunks.sol: The more one practiced it, the more one became a jiangshi. It was a poisoned Holy Grail, but the Son of Heaven seemed to have drunk from it willingly.

hunks.baseline: Even in an age when the Three Bonds and Five Relationships were held sacred, they meant nothing if you couldn’t breathe.
hunks.sol: Even in an age when the Three Bonds and Five Relationships were alive and well, they meant nothing if you couldn’t breathe.

hunks.baseline: Not when he had only one blood relative who could take on all the burdens he carried.
hunks.sol: Especially when he had one blood relative who would have to shoulder all his burdens.

hunks.baseline: And the Son of Heaven wasn’t the only one who had someone to protect.
hunks.sol: And the Son of Heaven wasn’t the only one with someone to protect.

hunks.baseline: From the great Murim sects to reclusive masters hidden deep in the mountains, all the way down to Third Rate swordsmen.
hunks.sol: Great Murim sects, reclusive masters hidden deep in the mountains, even third-rate swordsmen.

hunks.baseline: Countless ships covered the rivers, while the thunder of galloping hooves shook the earth.
hunks.sol: Countless ships covered the rivers, while galloping hooves shook the earth.

hunks.baseline: Some of those who had cowered in fear must have felt ashamed. Others must have blamed themselves for not being there to fight alongside us.
hunks.sol: Some who had cowered in fear must have felt ashamed. Others must have blamed themselves for not being there to fight alongside us.

hunks.baseline: But the reason didn’t matter.
hunks.sol: But their reasons didn’t matter.

hunks.baseline: At my sudden words, Mae Jonghak—whose face had been stern the entire time—bit his lip.
hunks.sol: At my sudden words, Mae Jonghak, whose face had been stern the entire time, bit his lip.

hunks.baseline: I met Mae Jonghak’s wavering gaze and added quietly:
hunks.sol: I met Mae Jonghak’s wavering gaze and added quietly,

hunks.baseline: “They chose their path. They’d already accepted that they might die, and they fought as though they meant it. More bravely than anyone.”
hunks.sol: “They chose their path. They’d already accepted that they might die, and they fought with all the resolve that took. More bravely than anyone.”

hunks.baseline: And so had those who, like Mae Jonghak before me, had struggled behind the scenes for this great victory.
hunks.sol: So had those who, like Mae Jonghak before me, had struggled behind the scenes for this great victory.

hunks.baseline: And someone else, bound up with him.
hunks.sol: And with it, the name of someone else bound to him.

hunks.baseline: One day, thick snow fell like it was the middle of winter. The next, a storm of wind and rain swept through as if it meant to swallow the whole world.
hunks.sol: One day, thick snow fell as though it were the middle of winter. On another, wind and rain raged as if they meant to swallow the whole world.

hunks.baseline: Then, three days after I regained consciousness, a sight I’d never seen before came into view beyond the shimmering heat haze raised by the blazing sun.
hunks.sol: Then, three days after I regained consciousness, a sight I’d never seen before appeared beyond the heat haze rising in the blazing sun.

hunks.baseline: The war drums of Xining City, silent for ten days, began to toll with a deep resonance. But not a trace of fear showed on the faces of the people crowding the walls.
hunks.sol: The war drums of Xining City, silent for ten days, sounded their deep call. But not a trace of fear showed on the faces of the people crowding the walls.

hunks.baseline: North, south, east, and west.
hunks.sol: East, west, south, and north.

hunks.baseline: Across the winding hills, the vast plains, and along the Yellow River—a wave of countless banners surged toward us.
hunks.sol: Across winding hills and vast plains, and along the Yellow River, a wave of countless banners surged toward us.

hunks.baseline: There’s always some lunatic who can’t read the room, wherever you go.
hunks.sol: Wherever you go, there’s always some lunatic who can’t read the room.

hunks.baseline: “Are you not listening to me? Prepare for battle at once!”
hunks.sol: “Do you not hear me? Prepare for battle at once!”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang watched the Great Sir hopping up and down, then turned to me.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang watched Great Sir hopping up and down, then turned to me.

hunks.baseline: “So what if he’s useful in battle? Every time that man opens his mouth, I feel like I’m about to suffer qi deviation.”
hunks.sol: “What good is he in battle if every time he opens his mouth, I feel like I’m about to suffer qi deviation?”

hunks.baseline: They said he’d been darting all over the battlefield like Hong Gil-dong, saving a whole lot of our people. But after the battle, he’d become plain old Gil-dung.
hunks.sol: They said he’d darted all over the battlefield like Hong Gil-dong, saving a great many of our people. But after the battle, he’d become plain old Gil-dung.

hunks.baseline: Like a pile of shit right in the middle of the road, he was someone everyone edged around.
hunks.sol: A pile of shit planted in the middle of the road, with everyone edging around it.

hunks.baseline: The one saving grace was that even ordinary people now knew the Great Sir wasn’t just any lunatic.
hunks.sol: The one saving grace was that even ordinary people now knew Great Sir wasn’t just any lunatic.

hunks.baseline: I was listening to a conversation between commoners who knew a suspicious amount about martial-arts clichés when—
hunks.sol: I was listening to these commoners, who knew a suspicious amount about martial-arts clichés, when—

hunks.baseline: The pounding of hooves shook the earth, and an enormous cheer erupted, swallowing up the scattered murmurs in an instant.
hunks.sol: The pounding of hooves shook the earth, and an enormous cheer swallowed the scattered murmurs.

hunks.baseline: The flags swelled as the wind that had just blown in from far away caught them, carrying that feverish roar with it.
hunks.sol: At that moment, a wind blew in from far away. The banners caught it and billowed above the feverish crowd.

hunks.baseline: The overlords of the various provinces, the large and small Murim sects that followed them—and five words unfamiliar to some: Nanman Beast Palace.
hunks.sol: The overlords of the various provinces, the large and small Murim sects that followed them—and a name unfamiliar to some: Nanman Beast Palace.

hunks.baseline: And among all those names fluttering fiercely toward the sky, two banners rose higher and larger than the rest.
hunks.sol: Among all those names fluttering fiercely toward the sky, two banners rose higher and larger than the rest.

hunks.baseline: The martial artists of Xining were moved at the sight of the banner that represented them. The government troops and commoners, meanwhile, stared wide-eyed at the sight of a man they’d thought they would never meet in their lives.
hunks.sol: The martial artists of Xining were moved at the sight of the banner that represented them. The government troops and commoners, meanwhile, stared wide-eyed at the presence of a man they’d thought they would never meet in their lives.

hunks.baseline: The people who spotted the brilliant golden dragon embroidered on a banner, impossible to hide even behind the thick heat haze, all dropped to their knees and bowed.
hunks.sol: The brilliant golden dragon embroidered on his banner shone through even the thick heat haze. At the sight of it, people dropped to their knees and bowed low.

hunks.baseline: “This is a sight. What a sight.”
hunks.sol: “What an uproar. A real uproar.”

hunks.baseline: As if to prove Jeok Cheongang’s muttering right, the whole place was in an uproar.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang was right. The whole place had gone wild.

hunks.baseline: Some people slammed their heads against the wall until blood ran down. Others wailed as though they were about to faint.
hunks.sol: Some slammed their heads against the wall until they bled. Others wailed as though they were about to faint.

hunks.baseline: They weren’t even close enough to see his face yet, and this was how they were acting.
hunks.sol: The procession was only just drawing close enough to make out. They hadn’t even seen his face, and this was how they were acting.

hunks.baseline: At this rate, you could call him the three-generation ruling family of North Korea—or an unlucky Lord of Heaven—and no one could argue.
hunks.sol: At this rate, you could call him North Korea’s three ruling Kims—or an unlucky Lord of Heaven—and no one could argue.

hunks.baseline: “No, you’re not wrong, but you should still watch it…”
hunks.sol: “No, you’re not wrong, but still, look around…”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang silently twitched his nose for a moment, then turned away.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang’s nose twitched silently for a moment. Then he turned away and watched the procession draw nearer.

hunks.baseline: Watching the procession rapidly draw nearer, he muttered as though to himself.
hunks.sol: He muttered as though to himself.

hunks.baseline: “God, what a nice day. It’s a beautiful day, but my one and only Disciple is so damn clueless…”
hunks.sol: “Ah, what a nice day. A beautiful day, and my one and only disciple is so damn clueless…”

hunks.baseline: I was just about to let out the snicker I’d been holding back at the sight of his nostrils flaring now too, when—
hunks.sol: His nostrils were flaring now too, and I was just about to let out the snicker I’d been holding back when—

hunks.baseline: Grrrummmble.
hunks.sol: Grrrrumble.

hunks.baseline: Beneath the people’s cheers, joy and tears mingled together.
hunks.sol: The people cheered, joy and tears mingling in their voices.

hunks.baseline: The ruler of the continent, who could drive both fans and haters—or rather, the common people—mad just by showing up.
hunks.sol: The ruler of the continent, who could drive fans and haters—or rather, the common people—mad just by showing up.

hunks.baseline: But unlike some miserable bastard lurking beyond that desert, this ersatz Lord of Heaven was on our side. That was what mattered.
hunks.sol: But unlike some miserable bastard lurking beyond the desert, this ersatz Lord of Heaven was on our side. That was what mattered.

hunks.baseline: At last, he crossed the city gates and stepped into Xining. He smiled gently at me as I stood there with my back impudently straight.
hunks.sol: He crossed the city gates and entered Xining at last. I stood there with my back impudently straight, and he smiled gently at me.
